palette_basis: User-supplied street photos show red-brown brick, pale projecting cornices, dark frames, recessed balconies and planted edges. Color matching is approximate because of daylight, perspective and image processing; exact products and recess depths remain assumed.

site.basis: Bilinear grade approximation from the sloping elevation lines; sidewalks, street strips and landscape props are presentation context, not a site survey.

limitations: Exterior drawing study, not verified installed conditions.
The dimensioned plan grids control footprint scale. Elevation grid spans do not agree uniformly with the plan; facade widths use explicit piecewise registration.
No single dimensional accuracy tolerance is established for this exterior model. Source picks, simplified wall returns and standardized window heights remain provisional/assumed.
Facade openings are surface-envelope studies; jamb details, exact opening schedule and recessed balconies are simplified.
R1/P1 lower enclosure is simplified because the architectural P1 plan was not supplied.
Roof slopes, drains, equipment, landscaping, sidewalk and street geometry are simplified; surrounding buildings are omitted.
Finish families follow the user photos; exact colors, reflectance, recess depth and landscape positions remain interpreted.
Not suitable for quantities, facade access design or construction dimensions.
Visible front bays have been reassigned within the registered plan topology; their exact opening offsets remain assumed. Rear/north omitted candidates remain unresolved.
Plan jambs and wall placement are provisional raster measurements, not scheduled opening sizes. Source sheets have local registration differences; no single building accuracy tolerance is asserted.
The inherited footprint remains unchanged. North stair-window depth stays on the simplified north envelope rather than acquiring an unsupported reconstructed stair recess.
Sill/head levels and complete frame sections remain assumed. Window marks identify the visible elevation pattern; the window schedule and A4/A5 detail sheets are still absent.
R1 north openings are outside this bounded correction and retain the prior assumed geometry. The new drawing evidence also calls for a separate R1 north door/entry audit.

Terrace-band heights stay provisional. A2.08 confirms top-elevation callouts already used, but A4/A5 profiles and exterior guard sections are not supplied. Stair guard details do not establish exterior terrace guards.
Drawings are dated 04-02-07 and carry handwritten ASI/RFI references without complete response records. They do not establish current installed conditions.

revision_basis.source: Owner photo-02; A2.03/A2.04 registered outlines; A3.01 south/east elevation crops
revision_basis.scope: Front south bays, continuous floor-edge appearance, wide-window divisions and balcony infill character.
revision_basis.limits: Exact opening offsets remain assumed. Ten rail rows and section sizes interpret the drawing character; they are not a verified guard schedule. Building grid, story heights, roof/parapet datums and footprint are unchanged.

vertical_registration.method: Manual picks on repeated floor-level ticks in the A3.01 south crop; paired with the inherited floor datums. Approximate scan measurement, not a new documented dimension.

terrace_bands.source: A3.01 south elevation / central pair of MN windows; south.png
terrace_bands.basis: Parapet top scaled about 28 inches above the R5 tick. Returns follow the inherited typical polygon. Complete geometry remains assumed; scaled top is provisional with about +/-3 inch pick uncertainty. Coping section is assumed.

terrace_bands.source: A3.01 south elevation / MQ window cornice; photo-02
terrace_bands.basis: Cornice top scaled about 26 inches above the R5 tick. Profile and return sections interpret the elevation and photograph; no detail sheet establishes their actual section. Height provisional, section assumed.

terrace_bands.source: A3.01 south/east elevations / MM window and east projecting bay cornice; photo-02
terrace_bands.basis: The pale band wraps the southeast window fields in the elevation/photo. Its top scales about 30 inches above the R5 tick. Projection, continuity around short returns and complete section are assumed; top has about +/-3 inch pick uncertainty.

roof_coping.source: A2.08 roof.png / T.O. PARAPET 406.25 and 407.75; inherited tower tops 415.00 and 414.41
roof_coping.basis: Use the stated top datum as the complete modeled parapet/coping top. No separate coping-top datum is available. Sections remain assumed. Remove the previous per-segment vertical offsets and miter adjacent caps in plan.

window_dividers.source: A3.01 south elevation / repeated mirrored MN pair in south.png
